info.name: Abonnieren
info.summary: Flexible file and folder subscriptions with private, reliable notifications
info.description:
Subscribe to individual files or folders and choose how Nextcloud informs you when other people upload, modify, delete or download content.
## Flexible subscriptions
- Create and remove rules directly in the Files sidebar or from **My subscriptions**. - Subscribe recursively to folders, with more specific rules overriding inherited settings. - Choose email, native Nextcloud notifications, or both for each subscription. - Configure suppression windows, extension and folder exclusions, quiet hours, hourly or daily digests, temporary subscriptions and snoozing.
## Reliable delivery
- Email is delivered asynchronously so uploads and downloads are not blocked by SMTP failures. - Temporary failures are retried with bounded backoff, and related uploads can be grouped into one summary. - Access and subscription permissions are checked again immediately before delayed delivery.
## Privacy-aware notifications
- Notifications use the path visible to the recipient and never persist public-share tokens. - Revoked or inaccessible content is cancelled and scrubbed before delivery. - Internal preview, cron, CLI and Office/WOPI reads are not reported as user downloads. - A subscriber's own authenticated actions are excluded.
Supports Nextcloud 34 and 35, including SQLite, MariaDB and PostgreSQL installations.
info.author: Timm Meisinger
